context: following are suggested for Cheetah use as an aid for computed tomography. Upper G.I. Opacification The patient should drink approximately 200 to 300 mL of ready-to-use Cheetah approximately 30 to 45 minutes before the CT scan and an additional 200 to 300 mL approximately 5 to 10 minutes pri

ination. For rapid upper gastrointestinal tract transit, administer the product chilled. Total Bowel Opacification The patient should drink 250 to 450 mL of Cheetah approximately 1 to 2 hours before the examination and another 250 to 450 mL of suspension 5 to 10 minutes prior to the CT scan.
